title: Solo tour but very enriching.
text:
Very informative the very professional guide and shared interesting facts of the city, even though it was only me alone on the tour without any other, I did not cancel it and only gave the tour for me. 
That speaks to your professionalism, Ramon Caraballo.
author: Alejandra_G

title: Paola i Tomas -great guide
text:
We went on tour with Tomas and Paola. Tomas has shown us Triana. He is great guide, he had tablet and he shown us old photos of town. 
Paola is also great frendly guide. She has shown us old Sevilla center. She speak english perfect. We had great time with them.
author: OnAir53267767992

title: Perfect guide around Seville on foot.
text: Alba was a good tourist guide, with a lot of knowledge of the city and its historical places. It was a fun and interesting experience. She spoke quietly, so I could understand most of it. I am learning Spanish and the guide was perfect for my level (B1-B2)
author: Evan B

title: Excellent guide Thomas!
text: We have taken the guided tour of the monumental buildings with Thomas. The truth has been splendid, he explained everything to us very clearly, you can tell that he likes what he does and that he knows a lot. (Thank you for that!) we have known a lot and above all about your story. And no less, we could do it with our teckel dog. 👏🏼
author: Georgina L

title: free tour with red umbrella (shots)
text: We loved the tour. it has been very entertaining with interesting explanations but without being heavy. tomas kept the attention of the group at all times, very friendly and professional. 2hours, just enough to see the important sites. thanks Thomas!!
author: miguelgE7306IO

title: VISIT BARRIO DE TRIANA
text: WE ARE GUIDED BY SHOTS OF THE TRIANA AND LUXURY NEIGHBORHOOD, TELL US THE HISTORY OF ALL THESE PLACES WITH HISTORICAL PHOTOS. RECOMMENDED.
author: Trail47363133352

title: Free Walking Tour Santa Cruz
text: It was my third walk with the guys from Heart of Seville and my second with Antonio. It was so amazing to walk with him through charming  Santa Cruz. Listen to historical facts as well as to legends like 'Doña Susona' or the myth of "Don Juan'. Antonio did a wonderful job and I Highlights recommend to go with him and discover beautiful Seville. THANKS A LOT.
author: martinasV6710FC

title: Paola spectacular. Highly recommended.
text:
Thank you Paola, for your explanations, I love that you have done our tour and everything we have learned from the history of Triana. 
When we get back to Seville, we'll look for you for sure, for another tour. 
People like you make us always have a great memory of your city. 
We wait for you in Zaragoza, to see my Holy Week.
author: meiglesiass

title: Triana Tour with Alba
text: We did the Triana tour with Alba, spectacular! Unmissable to know the history of the other side of the river. Very entertaining and interesting! Highly recommended!
author: adav734

title: Excellent tour of Triana
text: Excellent tour of Triana area of Seville. So much to learn about the history of the city which we did not understand from the traditionally tourist centre of Seville. Alba was a great tour leader, very knowledgeable, informative and enthusiastic about the history of Triana. Great tour!
author: grahamhQ6307BY
